dialect.detail: MetaWare Technologies COBOL-Translater 0.9.16 (2016) — translates mainframe-style COBOL to GnuCOBOL/open-source target; uses ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL, COMP-5, and translator comment markers like *{ Tr-Select-Sequential 1.3 and *{ convert-comp-comp4-binary-to-comp5 1.8

purpose.domain_detail: Retail assortment/label management system — merges stock/transit assortment file (FCE618S from KLEE3) with demo assortment file (FCE618D from SL11/CE13) into a combined output file (FCE618) sent to KLEE6
purpose.summary: BCE618 is a batch program that reads two input sequential files (FCE618S for stock/transit assortment and FCE618D for demo assortment), merges them by key, and writes a combined assortment output file (FCE618). It is part of an 'ETIQUETTE - ASSORTIMENT' (label/assortment) project, likely for retail merchandise management.

notable_features: EXEC SQL present (DB2 SQL, though some SQL sections are commented out)
COPY statements: SYBWDIV0, SYBWERRO, ABENDCOP, WORKDATC
MetaWare COBOL-Translater migration markers in comments
verdict.notes: Source was truncated to first 16000 chars; PROCEDURE DIVISION content not fully visible. The file is a MetaWare-translated version of an IBM mainframe COBOL program, with original mainframe syntax preserved in comments and translated GnuCOBOL-compatible syntax as active code. French comments throughout confirm European retail context. EXEC SQL sections appear largely commented out in the visible portion.
